item.title: Las Vegas woman details tracing family history back to 1735 slave ship
item.description: Sherry Lynn Blackwell, a Las Vegas-based artist, turned her living room into a makeshift museum of her family history. As jazz music from a distant relative played, she went back to the very beginning.

item.title: Las Vegas police: Man took upskirt photos of 6-year-old girl in fast-food restaurant
item.description: A man took up-skirt photos of a 6-year-old girl inside a Las Vegas fast-food restaurant, leading to his arrest and Metro police’s request for other potential victims to come forward, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: Las Vegas math teacher accused of sending explicit videos to 13-year-old amid inappropriate relationship
item.description: A Las Vegas math teacher allegedly sent a 13-year-old student naked videos of himself as part of an inappropriate relationship that lasted months, according to documents 8 News Now obtained Thursday.

item.title: Overnight ramp closure near Las Vegas Airport Connector to begin as part of ongoing project
item.description: Drivers in the Las Vegas valley should prepare for delays as an overnight ramp closure near the Airport Connector is set to take place over the weekend.

item.title: Closing arguments wrap in Anthony Newton murder trial
item.description: The case of Anthony Newton, who faces the death penalty, saw its closing arguments Thursday.

item.title: Unanswered questions after FDA action at Las Vegas mammography clinic
item.description: Questions remain about the revocation of Summerlin Hospital Medical Center's mammography clinic's accreditation. Patients who received a mammogram there over the past two years were informed of a failure, the 8 News Now Investigators first reported.

item.title: 2 hospitalized in critical condition after shooting east of Las Vegas Strip
item.description: Two people were hospitalized in critical condition after a shooting east of the Las Vegas Strip, according to Metro police.

item.title: Portion of I-11 shut down following crash, causes delay for drivers
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- A portion of Interstate 11 has closed following a crash in the area on Thursday, causing a major backup for drivers. item.title: Las Vegas police: Father, not officers, killed 3-year-old son in hostage situation, video shows
item.description: A father, not Las Vegas Metro police officers, shot and killed his 3-year-old son during a hostage shooting, police said Thursday.

item.title: Man dies after found lying in blood in central Las Vegas valley
item.description: A man is dead after he was found lying in blood in the central Las Vegas valley Thursday night, according to Metro police.
